body:
## Current scope and status — 2026-10-06 (America/Los_Angeles)

Global campaign: #1202, deliverables 1–2. This issue is the sole owner of **worldwide normative-native observations, location contexts, classification/triage, three ranked queues and actionable research/repair batches**. #1164 owns complete gap geometry/components/lineage; do not regenerate or duplicate its producer here.

Execution consumes #1164's independently reviewed merged and byte-verified products; #1164 is closed and this issue is actively claimed. The complete context stage is independently reviewed in PR #1217 and its existing normal queue run is finishing integration. The second focused PR owns complete native observations, classification, three ranked views and disjoint batches; that work is being prepared while the context stage merges. Current-geography successor #1215 / PR #1222 is independently accepted and awaiting its remaining hosted check/normal queue. Existing-world native assessment proceeds independently of that successor. There is no dependency on closing #1202 or #7, and no deployment is authorized here.

### Existing-world results must not wait for the pilot

Consume the authenticated existing release selected by #1164 and its corresponding normative native grid. Verify complete encoded/decoded native partitions, latitude stream, owner registry/order and exact release/hierarchy/footprint pins. **PR #1150 is not a prerequisite for the existing-world assessment.** Once a repair merges, refresh a separately pinned successor. Private candidate previews are preserved but never called installed/current.

### Acceptance — maximum two focused PRs

1. Account for all 95,174 original components and every selected successor component, every original/current location context (the original roster has 49,625), and every removed/retained/split/merged/new/unknown lineage. Preserve measurement vintages, exact identity/geometry/native/hierarchy bindings and complete relevant upstream input bytes. Never substitute an unchecked hash-only reference.
2. Publish normative native observations with explicit unassigned/multiple/owned/outside/failed/unknown and old/new applicability. A representative point is an observation, not whole-cell/component land or ownership approval. Report source-footprint gaps, rendering/grid discrepancies, overlaps, independently supported water and source disagreement as distinct supported or uncertain categories; unresolved physical interpretation remains unknown and goes to research.
3. Refresh all three complete ranked orders and exact case/contact/issue joins against a fresh bounded paginated issue snapshot. Preserve original rankings as archived. Every component is accounted for; no arbitrary area cutoff, nearest-owner assignment, water masking, omitted unknowns or score-driven factual approval.
4. Deliver a small prioritized set of disjoint actionable batches grouped by shared boundary/source/cause, not an issue per pixel. Each batch includes component/neighbor IDs, coordinate/extent evidence, known versus uncertain cause, source/date limits, existing related work, responsible role and next action. Reuse existing regional issues and workers' owned packets; only genuinely distinct bounded work merits a new child. Geography researches evidence/proposals; engineering owns shared tooling, coordinated core repairs and release revalidation.
5. Commit owned producers before two complete final runs. Verify every output with complete native/grid/latitude/owner-order/source/context/lineage/issue-binding negatives, historical-vintage laundering negatives, no-data/unknown retention and complete ranked membership/order controls. Obtain distinct exact-head reviews, normal hosted checks/queue merge and full byte readback. Preserve all failed attempts and earlier vintages.

Keep the existing 32MiB decoded-file, 256MiB reader and 512-descriptor limits; calculate complete input/output closure before splitting. Separate native-context and ranking PRs only if needed to retain complete ordinary input accounting. Do not create another infrastructure successor by default; a genuinely necessary split must identify the concrete remaining deliverable and measured obstacle.

All former #1164 native/context/ranking acceptance lives here; none is removed. Global repairs are deliverable 3 under #1202 and existing coordinated cases. #920's prevention implementation remains completed; research proposals still require source review and engineering integrations still consume its actual candidate gate report.

No core geography repair, source-packet edits, snapping/buffering/MakeValid/fill-by-proximity, political attribution, browser, production/provider/database writes, deployment or publisher messages. Delivery #907 remains user-deferred. This issue can close after its assessment/triage outputs are accepted; #1202 remains open for the repairs and delivery needed to satisfy the global outcome.


<details>
<summary>Original specification preserved (superseded routing; evidence remains valid)</summary>

Raised 2026-10-06 (America/Los_Angeles). Bounded engineering child of #1164 for the full worldwide coverage-gap goal #7. This stage split preserves every original #1164 acceptance criterion; it does not reduce the worldwide scope or authorize closing #1164 before this child's results are complete and verified.

Private measured previews show complete component/connectivity/crosswalk products121,512,609 encoded bytes and native-context/ranking outputs43,661,954 encoded bytes, before complete original/source/native/hierarchy/issue inputs. The combined single-packet input/output closure exceeds the existing256MiB evidence-reader budget. Every individual generated preview file is below8.4MiB decoded; byte totals are planning evidence only, not a validated final manifest or passed producer execution. Separate reviewed stages instead of dropping rows, suppressing unknowns or weakening budgets.

This child does not depend on #1164 being closed: it depends on its staged independently reviewed products being actually merged and byte-verified. Keeping the parent open until this child is verified avoids a circular completion dependency.

Consume the actual independently reviewed immutable full-world fragment/component/crosswalk products delivered under #1164, and authenticated installed geography after actual #1150 merge, exact reviewed changed-byte readback and selected release verification. Until those are available, only explicit private candidate/fixture previews may proceed. Never call a candidate installed/current. Preserve original source measurement vintages, all removed/retained/split/merged/new/unknown component links, tiny/line/point residues and original IDs.

Reassess ALL95,174 original physical-reference components and every successor component against selected normative native latitude/row/run semantics. Verify complete native encoded/decoded parts and owner-ID order; use normative stored latitude bytes, exact cell/row/run rules and stable subject keys. A historical projected representative sample is not a current native measurement. Preserve representativeness, failed/no-data/ambiguous/multiple/unassigned/outside-centre distinctions; a one-point observation cannot claim full-cell or full-component coverage. Explain the actual scope of every status and retain explicit uncertainty.

Account for ALL49,625 original and successor location contexts, with explicit old/new applicability and complete identity/geometry/hierarchy/native pins. Refresh all THREE complete ranked queues and exact issue/contact joins using fresh bounded paginated issue snapshots. Preserve original metrics as archived. Historical sample transfer is permitted only with explicit complete authenticated original-to-current crosswalk custody and the measurement vintage carried forward; do not relabel it as native, source authority or current physical-water classification.

Maximum two focused PRs, with a hard exact-descriptor input/output closure calculation before choosing stage boundaries. Consume full relevant upstream files through explicit immutable manifest/source descriptors and verified bytes, not unchecked hash-only references. Any lossless geometry/record normalization must prove complete exact reconstruction and preserved IEEE/source-edge/GEOS semantics; do not invent approximation merely to fit. Keep256MiB total reader budget,32MiB per-file decoded limit and512 descriptors. If two PRs are insufficient, report exact measured closure and create a bounded linked successor without dropping acceptance requirements.

Commit owned producers before two actual final runs. Add meaningful controls for normative latitude, owner-ID/order, altered/missing source bytes, stale release/context/hierarchy/issue snapshots, historical-vintage laundering, split/merge/removed/unknown custody, unknown/no-data retention, exact issue joins, cross-tile/dateline applicability and complete three-queue membership. Full changed-file evidence and distinct exact-head code/geometry/release review, hosted checks and normal queue remain required. Deliver a bounded actionable handoff of confirmed versus uncertain source cases and regression-gate inputs.

No core geometry repair, political attribution, source-packet edits, snapping/buffering/MakeValid/nearest-owner assignment, production/provider/database writes, deployment or publisher messages. No browser. This item does not close #7, source unknowns, geographic approval/certificates, #972 or deferred delivery #907. #1164 remains incomplete until both its own stages and this child satisfy the original acceptance.
